sentences.en: My horizons are broader than your pupils after cannabis consumption!
sentences.zh: 与你吸食大麻后的瞳孔相比，我的视野更开阔!

sentences.en: Illegal turtle hunting for purposes of consumption is still present.
sentences.zh: 非法捕猎龟类用于食用的现象仍然存在。

sentences.en: Consumption is the sole end and purpose of all production.
sentences.zh: 生产的目的唯有消费而已。

senses.zh: 消费，消耗；消费[耗]量 - 肺病；结核病
